title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Room warnings that came back on their own
summary: Switching the Room migration drift detection off while it was reading the workspace published its warnings again a few seconds later.

highlights.title: Warnings that outlived the switch
highlights.description: The detector reads every Kotlin file before publishing. Turning it off during that read did not stop the scan already in flight.

highlights.title: Writing to a collection that is gone
highlights.description: The provider had no disposal flag, so a scan landing after the extension is gone wrote to a diagnostic collection the editor had already destroyed.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Room migration warnings stay off once the detection is switched off, even mid scan.
A scan that lands after the provider is disposed no longer writes to the Problems panel.
